info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Cancellation API
info.description: The Settlement Cancellation API allows users to revoke or cancel existing settlements by providing the unique settlement identifier. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate financial records and managing transaction disputes. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment processors, this API ensures that erroneous or unwanted settlements can be efficiently handled. By integrating this endpoint, developers can enhance their applications' financial transaction management capabilities.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to permanently delete a settlement identified by RES-100045 from the system. The deletion will remove all associated records and cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary for deleting a specific settlement identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the required fields as defined in the schema.
